title: The Critical Role of 12-Methyl Group of Anthracycline Dutomycin to Its Antiproliferative Activity.
authors: Xu, Ruoxuan; Hu, Dinghang; Lin, Jinlian; Tang, Jie; Zhan, Ruoting; Liu, Guiyou; Sun, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蒽环类化合物与DNA的结合及抗增殖活性，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-DNA互作，非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法简单，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Anthracycline dutomycin is a tetracyclic quinone glycoside produced by Streptomyces minoensis NRRL B-5482. SW91 is a C-12 demethylated dutomycin derivative, which was identified in our previous research. In vitro cytotoxicity and apoptosis assays of these two compounds were conducted to demonstrate their antiproliferation activities. The results showed that both dutomycin and SW91 block cells at the S phase, whereas dutomycin shows more significant inhibition of cell growth. Their interactions with calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) were investigated, with dutomycin exhibiting higher binding affinity. The molecular docking demonstrated that the 12-methyl group makes dutomycin attach to the groove of DNA. These findings suggest that dutomycin has binding higher affinity to DNA and impairs DNA replication resulting in more significant antitumor activity.
abstract_zh: 蒽环类抗生素dutomycin是由小单孢菌Streptomyces minoensis NRRL B-5482产生的四环醌糖苷。SW91是C-12去甲基化的dutomycin衍生物，在我们先前的研究中已鉴定。对这两种化合物进行了体外细胞毒性和凋亡实验，以证明其抗增殖活性。结果表明，dutomycin和SW91均将细胞阻滞于S期，而dutomycin对细胞生长的抑制作用更为显著。研究了它们与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的相互作用，dutomycin表现出更高的结合亲和力。分子对接表明，12-甲基使dutomycin附着于DNA的沟槽。这些发现提示，dutomycin对DNA具有更高的结合亲和力，并损害DNA复制，从而产生更显著的抗肿瘤活性。
